name: attackmap-docs
description: docs.mlaify.io — AttackMap documentation. Node is here only to pin wrangler, the Cloudflare deploy tool; the site itself is built by MkDocs (see requirements.txt).

scripts.build:cf: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --disable-pip-version-check -q -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/mkdocs build --strict && find site -name '*.map' -delete && bash scripts/check-build.sh
